name: Nikola Tesla
source:
"I bought you for 30 silver coins. In other words, you're mine. Body and soul."

A protagonist and the hero of this story. The first transfer student in the history of the Academia and the president of the Speculative Detective Club (an organization he founded himself). By all appearances, he's a clean-cut young man in early adulthood. Tesla himself, however, claims to be 72 years of age.

His past is full of mystery. Some say he spent years working in a prominent research institution in the USA; others claim that he's a globe-trotting revolutionary with a long history of insurrectionary activities. There are even those who believe him to be a mortal enemy of Lord Edison, a founding father of the United States. Tesla himself refuses to dignify any of these rumors with a response.

On his very first day as a transfer student, he declared the Academia's Governing Council to be his enemy, established the Speculative Detective Club, and stated his intention to lead the entire school down a nobler and more righteous path.

Always overflowing with confidence. Composed and cool-headed. As one might expect of a self-styled 72-year-old, he's oblivious to social rules that would be common sense for most students, and struggles to understand the sensibilities of the young people around him. Despite his flowery talk of ideals, he's not the most compassionate or considerate individual. His assistant Neon suffers lamentable treatment in his employ. However... when someone asks for his help, even a bitter enemy who's attempted to do him harm, he will absolutely never forsake them.

[Taken from the [url=http://mangagamer.org/gahkthun/]English Official Website[/url]]
